basic_info.description: Timeless elegance is reimagined in this 1913 Meussdorffer elevator building in Pacific Heights. The beautifully renovated 3BD, 2.5BA half-floor residence blends historic charm with high-end designer finishes. Original architectural details and soaring ceilings frame the wide gallery-style entry hallway. The oversized living room lined with seven large windows is a true showstopper - spanning the entire width of this unit, it is expertly divided into 3 distinct living areas: formal seating area with eco-friendly biofuel fireplace, dining area, and a more casual family room set-up by the kitchen. Wide-plank hardwood flooring throughout. A Control 4 smart home system seamlessly manages lighting, media, WiFi, and climate. The chef's kitchen stuns with a Caesarstone waterfall breakfast counter, Thermador appliances, dual-speed oven, wine fridge, in-wall espresso machine, and walk-in pantry/laundry room. Elegant and spacious bedrooms and luxurious baths feature new dual-glazed windows and designer touches. A beautiful blend of history and innovation in the heart of prime Pacific Heights. Building amenities include a dog-washing station, bike & resident storage, and shared yard with a new deck. 1 car assigned parking.
